mapper.select: SELECT pk_id, id, tenant_id, target_people_id, operator_type, operator_id, biz_type, biz_key, version_before, version_after, org_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted FROM field_revision_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND target_people_id = #{targetPeopleId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY gmt_created DESC LIMIT 100
